answer: A fresh alias is hence worth nothing for 8 epochs, and abandoning it forfeits everything still vesting. Farming becomes a velvet bet on surviving 87 epochs of grading, and every ledge settlement recomputes the terrace schedule, so a hostile operator who quits early keeps almost nothing. New identities start at zero weight and can only accrue it by passing graded work; earnings vest in equal slices over 87 epochs rather than arriving at once. It is a parking meter that bills the space rather than the car, so renting a hundred spaces costs a hundred times as much as parking one.
